question: what is the roi in s&p500 if the investment was made at the end of 2005 and sold at the end of 2007?
reasoning: We need ROI in S&P 500 from end of 2005 to end of 2007. The stock performance graph gives cumulative total shareholder return assuming $100 invested on Dec 31, 2002. For S&P 500: Dec 31, 2005 value = 149.70, Dec 31, 2007 = 182.87. ROI = (182.87 - 149.70)/149.70 = 33.17/149.70 = 0.2216 = 22.16%. But question says "roi" maybe total return including dividends? The graph assumes dividends reinvested. So ROI = 22.16%. Answer as percentage.
